title: Financial Assistance Policy — Assigning a Patient Hardship Discount Program Level
content:
## Section 1. The guideline and the percentage

1.1 The poverty guideline for an applicant's household under the Patient Hardship Discount Program is the program's guideline for a household of one, plus the program's added amount for each household member beyond the first. With the figures the program has adopted, that is $15960.00 for a household of one and $5680.00 more for each further member.

1.2 The household's guideline percentage is household income divided by that guideline, multiplied by 100, and rounded by the program's rounding rule: down to a whole percent.

## Section 2. The level

2.1 The level is the one whose band, from its lowest to its highest guideline percentage, contains the household's percentage.

2.2 An applicant currently enrolled in one of the presumptive programs — SNAP, WIC, LIHEAP or homeless shelter — is approved at the Presumptive Eligibility Discount without income documents.

2.3 An applicant above 400 percent but within the Catastrophic Medical Hardship band qualifies there only when the open balance reaches the Catastrophic Medical Hardship minimum open patient balance for application.

## Section 3. Worked figures (hypothetical households)

| Household | Annual household income | Guideline | Income divided by guideline, multiplied by 100 | Rounded down | Band containing it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 people | $50000.00 | $21640.00 | 231.05 | 231 | Hardship Discount Level 3 (75%), 201 to 250 |
| 3 people | $54885.00 | $27320.00 | 200.89 | 200 | Hardship Discount Level 4 (100%), 0 to 200 |
| 2 people | $65000.00 | $21640.00 | 300.36 | 300 | Hardship Discount Level 2 (50%), 251 to 300 |
| 1 person | $70000.00 | $15960.00 | 438.59 | 438 | Above 400; within the Catastrophic Medical Hardship band, up to 600 |
| 1 person | $100000.00 | $15960.00 | 626.56 | 626 | No band contains it |

Notes on the worked figures:

- For the three-person household, the guideline is $15960.00 plus two further members at $5680.00 each. The unrounded 200.89 becomes 200 when rounded down, and 200 lies in the band that ends at 200.
- For the household at 300.36, rounding down gives 300, the top of the band from 251 to 300.
- For the one-person household at 438, Section 2.3 applies: it qualifies at Catastrophic Medical Hardship only when the open balance reaches that level's minimum open patient balance for application. An open balance equal to the minimum reaches it; a balance below it does not, and the household does not qualify there.

## Section 4. Presumptive enrollment

Current enrollment in SNAP, WIC, LIHEAP or homeless shelter places the applicant at the Presumptive Eligibility Discount under 2.2, without income documents.
